purpose: Development crosswalk showing where Course 4 water, root-zone, nutrition-context, irrigation, equipment-care and record objectives can be observed in Practical B. Mapping coverage does not constitute practical validation, evaluator calibration, inter-rater evidence, standard setting or release approval.

objectiveMappings.statement: Collect and identify the assigned water or nutrient-solution sample and obtain pH and EC readings using the supplied meter procedure while preserving units, sample identity, time and measurement context.
practicalTasks: Inspect and prepare pH/EC measurement equipment.
Verify calibration status and obtain representative measurements.
Record pH/EC with sample source, time and method.

objectiveMappings.statement: Describe root-zone moisture, saturation, drainage and dryback as repeated observations or trends rather than treating one reading or elapsed time alone as a complete irrigation diagnosis.
practicalTasks: Compare root-zone observations/dryback trend with prior records.

objectiveMappings.statement: Use pH, EC, developmental stage, root-zone condition and symptom pattern as diagnostic context while avoiding unsupported nutrient-deficiency, excess or antagonism claims.
practicalTasks: When a crop symptom card is assigned, use the supplied developmental stage, symptom pattern, pH/EC, root-zone and irrigation context to write a bounded interpretation that separates observed evidence from possible explanations and does not assign a nutrient deficiency, excess or antagonism without supporting evidence.
Escalate issues outside Technician I authority, including unresolved nutrition-like symptoms or conditions that would require recipe, treatment, repair or process redesign.
expectedEvidence: bounded nutrition-context interpretation when a symptom card is assigned
deliverables: nutrition-context note when a symptom card is assigned

objectiveMappings.statement: Execute an authorized routine irrigation or fertigation work order by confirming room or zone, material and required sequence, then verify representative delivery and document completion or deviation.
practicalTasks: Verify work order, room, batch and solution identity.
Inspect irrigation delivery points before or during the run.
Identify a local delivery failure and avoid changing the entire room to solve one emitter problem.

objectiveMappings.statement: Perform permitted operator-level irrigation and measurement-equipment readiness checks and escalate leaks, clogs, damaged tools, suspect meters, missed events or other unresolved faults without unauthorized repair.
practicalTasks: Inspect and prepare pH/EC measurement equipment.
Inspect irrigation delivery points before or during the run.
Escalate issues outside Technician I authority, including unresolved nutrition-like symptoms or conditions that would require recipe, treatment, repair or process redesign.

objectiveMappings.statement: Create reconstructable irrigation, measurement and root-zone records that distinguish target or work-order instructions from observed results, verification actions, unresolved conditions and shift-handoff needs.
practicalTasks: Record pH/EC with sample source, time and method.
Record actual irrigation completion, measurement results, nutrition-context observations and exceptions.
Escalate issues outside Technician I authority, including unresolved nutrition-like symptoms or conditions that would require recipe, treatment, repair or process redesign.
